purpose: SSOT for every regression test added by a v4.1.0 fix/fix-gate PR. Read by scripts/gate/check_fix_pr_test_registry.sh. Each entry pins a test file (or test bin name) that the corresponding PR must have added; deleting the file or renaming the bin name fails the gate. This is the fail-closed direction: the gate cannot be weakened by editing this file, only by writing a new entry per PR.
generated_by: audit of merged v4.1.0 fix PRs
policy: Every fix/fix-gate/feat/feat-gate PR merged into develop/v4.1.0 must add at least one of (a) a new test file under tests/ or crates/, or (b) a meaningful mutation to an existing test that exercises the bug being fixed. This registry is the audit's outcome and the gate's SSOT.
forbidden_actions: deleting the file or the bin name below — fails the gate
moving the test to `#[ignore]` without a registry ADR-008 exception — fails check_anti_ignore_gate.sh
